page_title: PAR 2-3 UDI | Parma v Udinese 16/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+4' Keinan Davis (Udinese) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
90+3' Drissa Camara (Parma) blasts the ball high over the crossbar.
90+1' Ange-Yoan Bonny (Parma) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
90+1' Parma seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Brenner (Udinese) unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, but it goes straight at Leandro Chichizola.
88' Substitution. Valentin Mihaila makes his way off the pitch and Drissa Camara (Parma) comes on as his replacement.
88' Here comes a substitution. Botond Balogh is given a rest as he is replaced by Antoine Hainaut (Parma).
87' Yellow card. Keinan Davis (Udinese) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
86' Hernani (Parma) tries to catch the keeper off guard from long range, but the effort sails well wide of the right post.
86' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Parma.
86' Woyo Coulibaly (Parma) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball is out of play. Parma win a corner kick.
85' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Parma.
85' Kosta Runjaic has decided to substitute Florian Thauvin and he is replaced by Brenner (Udinese).
84' Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) goes into the referee's book for dissent.
78' Possible change! There could be offside in the lead up. Referee Rosario Abisso wants to look at it, so he’s going to review using VAR.
77' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) has a goal ruled out for offside!
77' 2 - 3 Goal! Florian Thauvin (Udinese) fires the rebound into the bottom right corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 2:3.
77' Some patient build-up play from Udinese as they look to unlock the defence.
76' Keinan Davis (Udinese) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
73' RED CARD! Mandela Keita (Parma) makes a bad challenge and receives a second yellow card from Rosario Abisso. He can have an early bath.
71' Keinan Davis (Udinese) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Rosario Abisso no option but to blow his whistle.
70' A substitution has been made. Dennis Man is replaced by Pontus Almqvist (Parma).
70' Here is a change. Simon Sohm is going off and Fabio Pecchia gives the last tactical orders to Hernani (Parma).
68' 2 - 2 It's in the back of the net! Keinan Davis sprays a pass out to Florian Thauvin (Udinese), and he has an easy job to slot the ball into an empty net. The score is 2:2.
66' Kosta Runjaic has decided to make a change. Keinan Davis (Udinese) replaces Lorenzo Lucca.
66' A substitution has been made. Sandi Lovric goes off and Oier Zarraga (Udinese) comes on.
62' Mandela Keita (Parma) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
62' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
61' Udinese will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
61' Udinese failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
60' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
57' Dennis Man (Parma) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
56' The Udinese players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
55' Substitution. Matteo Cancellieri leaves the pitch and is replaced by Mandela Keita (Parma).
54' Now Udinese have a corner.
52' A defence splitting pass into the box is almost received by Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese), but Leandro Chichizola is quick enough and comes off his line to intercept the pass.
49' 2 - 1 Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) heads the ball into the bottom left corner of the goal after getting on the end of a brilliant delivery that was sent into the penalty box from out wide!
48' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
47' Ange-Yoan Bonny (Parma) steadies himself on the edge of the box and releases a precise effort on goal that just narrowly sails past the right post.
46' Half-time substitution. Lautaro Giannetti (Udinese) will not participate anymore and Christian Kabasele is coming on.
46' Here's the change. Martin Payero leaves the pitch and Jurgen Ekkelenkamp (Udinese) comes on as a substitute.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) throws the chance away as he attempts to produce a shot from inside the box. His attempt simply rattles the right post. The goalkeeper can remain calm.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
44' Rosario Abisso blows his whistle and signals a foul after Alessandro Circati (Parma) brought his opponent down.
43' 2 - 0 GOAL! Ange-Yoan Bonny (Parma) got to the ball in front of the goal and he couldn't miss from there. His low drive went in off the right-hand post. The score is 2:0.

42' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) bends the ball in from the edge of the box which worries the keeper, but it eventually sails just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Parma.
41' Ange-Yoan Bonny (Parma) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
40' Martin Payero (Udinese) commits a rough foul. Rosario Abisso stops the game and makes a call.
38' What was Lautaro Giannetti (Udinese) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
36' Jesper Karlstrom (Udinese) strikes the ball towards goal from distance, but it goes over the bar.

34' What a poor attempt! Hassane Kamara (Udinese) drives another shot towards goal - this time from further out, but it couldn't have been worse if he had shot blindfolded. The ball goes miles wide to the right. The ball goes out of play and Parma will have a goal kick.
32' None of the Parma players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.

31' Matteo Cancellieri (Parma) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Parma will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
31' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.
30' Ange-Yoan Bonny (Parma) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
29' A clumsy foul by Sandi Lovric (Udinese) and Rosario Abisso blows his whistle.
28' The ball is out of play and Udinese manage to earn a corner.

28' Martin Payero (Udinese) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders. The ball is out of play. Udinese will have a chance to score from a corner.
26' Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. It's a throw-in for Parma.
22' Close! Valentin Mihaila (Parma) unleashes a rocket of a shot from the edge of the box and his shot flies just a few inches over the crossbar.
20' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) swings in a cross from the corner, but Leandro Chichizola reads it well and gathers the ball.
20' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender. Udinese will take a corner kick.
19' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) latches on to a lofted pass and strikes the ball! His attempt flies narrowly wide of the right post.
19' The Udinese players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
15' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Parma.
15' Dennis Man (Parma) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the bottom right corner, but Maduka Okoye pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
14' Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Rosario Abisso blows for a foul.
11' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
9' Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) announces himself with a close-range shot after a cross, but one of the defenders gets in the way of the ball to thwart him.
8' Matteo Cancellieri (Parma) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort just wide of the left post.
6' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) hits a first-time shot from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal, but Leandro Chichizola is equal to the task and makes a comfortable save.
6' Udinese are seeing far more of the ball now.
5' Rosario Abisso couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Simon Sohm (Parma) and blew his whistle.
2' 1 - 0 Enrico Del Prato (Parma) comes face-to-face with the goalkeeper and smashes the ball into the bottom right corner!
1' Parma take a short corner kick.
1' The first half has just begun.
Udinese will kick-off.
Rosario Abisso will officiate today.
